purpose: Final held-out evaluation of Gao Haoyu's early warning and DI/risk/RUL workflows on RCSD semi-synthetic data

dataset.controlled_design: All existing 22 test blocks; replay + 3 groups x 3 exponents; five existing response variants on exponent=1 scenes only
dataset.generation_change: Separate test-only output; allow existing robustness definitions on test; add frozen test seed; reuse train amplitudes without re-estimation
dataset.rejections: Log bound violations and every planned/excluded scene; no favorable resampling or silent exclusions
dataset.stress_background_rule: All chronological nonoverlapping 1536-point chunks within pre-existing test baseline_candidate continuous segments; no choosing backgrounds by model performance
dataset.stress_amplitudes: Use existing dataset_v1/data/training_scales.csv and original speed-band rules, unchanged from development stress generator
dataset.legacy_v1_test: Not an additional primary test; optional future separate protocol, never merge its labels with controlled-v2 scores

warning.rules: All previous 26 method/seed/limit configurations retained; identical common support, thresholds, 3-high/4-low/0.7 recovery
warning.primary_metric: Paired new-event >=2h coverage before synthetic reference endpoint, separately by main/response variant/stress duration/amplitude
secondary: new events per valid running day
warning.censoring: No inferred endpoint for censored trajectories; retain traces and report counts separately
warning.empirical_label_warning: Raw replay alarm burden is not a true fault false-positive rate

di_risk.selection_basis: Lowest three-fold seed-averaged scene DI MAE in the already completed matched comparison
di_risk.lstm_budget_note: Keep the existing 40-epoch fixed-budget baseline; if cap reached, disclose it, do not extend or claim fully tuned LSTM performance
di_risk.postprocess: Keep raw prediction and clip DI to [0,1]; no added smoothing or calibration
di_risk.seed_policy: ET current/history and LSTM use all three seeds; deterministic methods use the reference seed

rul.selection_basis: Best average scene-macro RMSE in the completed matched 2x2 experiment; ET residual_augmented retained for endpoint tradeoff
rul.deduplicate: Reuse raw_original tree/GB models from raw-family comparison; do not count their identical predictions twice
rul.auxiliary_policy: Reuse exactly 360 previously generated scenes, 36 per B0010-B0019; no test-side augmentation enters training
rul.features: 125 current/24/96 mean/change features; optional estimated background subtraction of the same 12 targets
rul.eligibility: rul_label_valid, observed, noncensored, finite RUL>=0; include all usable zero endpoints; label filter is for training/evaluation, not detector input
rul.postprocess: clip negative prediction to zero, no upper lifetime cap or oracle onset correction
rul.primary_metric: Scene-macro RMSE hours; average seeds within model family, no best-seed choice

intervals.method: Maximum absolute error within each of the 11 calibration backgrounds; order ceil((n+1)*0.9), clipped lower bound at zero; no finite replacement if rank exceeds n
intervals.interpretation: Empirical coverage only; no exchangeability or field-lifetime guarantee

rul.legacy_candidates: Old 225-feature weighted trend model and old delivery model stay historical references; do not splice their 35.63% score into this newly matched experiment

global_metrics.shared_support: Within task identical source/scene/step keys across methods; always report excluded points and causes, censored scenes and generated/rejected scene counts
global_metrics.risk_stratified_rul: For the fixed primary DI pipeline, report RUL error/coverage/width by predicted I-IV risk; reference-risk breakdown separately named; do not hide difficult rows through warning gating
global_metrics.aggregation: Report every seed and every background, then seed means and ranges; main/response/stress never pooled into one success rate
global_metrics.uncertainty: For scalar main-set metrics, 2000 paired background bootstrap draws, seed 2026102404; keep all scenes of a background together and average model seeds inside each resample; label descriptive and within one machine
global_metrics.limitations: Public centrifugal compressor; synthetic DI/RUL references; shared-background dependence; no actual reciprocating-compressor fault/lifetime validation

release_gates: Fit final DI/RUL models only on the predefined training blocks; save source keys, inner selection curves, preprocessing and environment
Reconstruct reused 360 auxiliary scenes from recorded rules and allowed training source rows; verify no source overlap with calibration/test
Calibrate RUL intervals only on B0020-B0030; save exact finite-sample order statistic and all errors
Validate test-only generator by reproducing existing training/development examples before reading test observations
Verify causal inference, serialization, sample equality, missing/gap handling and zero endpoints; run development dry replay without further tuning
Write a final immutable manifest of all model, preprocessing, generator, scorer and protocol hashes
Only then generate reserved scenes in the separate directory, verify all planned inclusions/rejections and execute final scoring once
test_after_results_policy: Keep unfavorable outcomes; do not tune on final results. Bug-driven reruns require a versioned error record and retain original outputs.
not_required_before_test: AE/Embed-RUL exact replication unless the paper explicitly claims it
